changelog: Order entry now accepts phone numbers in any format — spaces, +91, or a leading 0 are cleaned automatically and only the 10-digit number is kept, so a stray space no longer throws an error.
Admin can now edit an order's item prices and quantities after it has been taken — totals, tax and balance recalculate on save.
When saving a new order a Yes/No popup asks whether to WhatsApp the customer the confirmation message; choose No to save silently (staff and designers are still notified either way).
